title: Uv is fantastic, but its package management UX is a mess
summary: This article critiques Uv, the high-performance Rust-based Python package manager, for its poor user experience despite excellent performance. The author identifies issues with inconsistent CLI commands, confusing virtual environment management, and unintuitive package dependency workflows that hinder developer productivity.
problem_solved: Highlights UX deficiencies in Uv's package management despite its blazing-fast performance, arguing that developer experience matters as much as speed.
why_valuable: Provides constructive feedback on real-world tooling issues, demonstrating that raw performance improvements are meaningless if the interface is confusing for developers.
